exceptional.message: Assumption failed: Optional EAEP artifact not supplied

measurement_notes: This entire run measured commit 70a138d in a new output directory; prior reports were not overwritten.
Full build reran the 1364 ordinary tests and 38 isolated boundary tests, with the boundary task required by the default test task.
Heavy Java validations executed sequentially; unrelated processes were not stopped.
Ordinary/channel/storage/cycle/soak families repeat in three fresh JVMs; boundary class repeats in three further fresh JVMs with its unchanged 1 s case limits.
Java pressure settings: Java 17, G1, Xms=256 MiB, Xmx=2 GiB, Xss=1 MiB, ActiveProcessorCount=4; only runner-owned Java processes use AboveNormal priority.
Large DAG fixtures have a 15 s outer deadline while internal production budgets remain unchanged.
JFR profile and GC/safepoint logs are enabled only for the full-build ordinary and boundary tasks. Heavy independent pressure uses separate GC logs.
Pooled nearest-rank latency excludes warmups; session latency covers eight probes. Cycle timing/allocation excludes supplement replanning and independent validation.
Channel uses one cold and four warmup calls per graph; storage/cycle/ordinary planner/certificate use three warmups per shape; side output uses one.
Every short-seed cycle result is supplemented, replanned and independently replayed, including all budget cutoffs.
fixture_hash_normalization: SHA-256 of source bytes with CRLF normalized to LF.
limitations: The optional real EAEP artifact is unavailable; one corresponding JUnit test is skipped.
External awrlib is unavailable; one Python reader test is skipped.
Forge auto/always use fresh verification worlds and no real GTLCore installation; this is not a full modpack TPS test.
Budget/quality cutoffs do not establish global optimality; short soak cannot prove absence of long-term leaks.
JFR is from this run and cannot establish the cause of the earlier unrecorded timeout. Fresh JVMs do not eliminate external scheduling pauses.
Logs, classpaths, JFR and raw fixtures remain local under ignored build output.
